build: lean and muscled from studio work, collarbones sharp
hair: black, straight, falls to mid-back; she clips it back with vintage silver pins when focused
complexion: warm ivory with golden undertone; a small scar on her left temple from a childhood accident with her father's woodworking tools
face: heart-shaped with a wide, mobile mouth—the kind of face that broadcasts every thought before she can stop it, dark eyes that go soft then fierce in the same breath
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, calloused from years of leatherwork, capable of both brutal precision and surprising gentleness; he notices the way she moves them when she talks
second_celebrated_feature: the hollow at the base of her throat, visible when she pulls her hair up—something he finds himself staring at when she's unguarded
signature_habits: she bites her lower lip when concentrating; she says 'eomma-ga' (mom always says) under her breath when nervous; she keeps a worn leather journal in her bag where she sketches designs at 3 AM when she can't sleep; she makes barley tea the way her grandmother taught her, letting it cool until it's almost bitter
occupation: leather goods designer and studio owner—a small independent label (6 employees) in a converted warehouse, bespoke and made-to-order; her pieces sell to high-end boutiques and directly to clients who know her work

current_crisis.event: a major investor pulled funding two weeks before her flagship collection was set to launch at a luxury pop-up; her studio rent is due in 10 days and she doesn't have the capital to cover both production and overhead
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic mixed with shame—she's convinced she's failed, that she's not good enough to survive in this world
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find $40K without losing creative control or admitting to anyone how close to collapse she is

wound.core: she believes her worth is tied entirely to her productivity and output; if she's not creating something, she's invisible
wound.surfacing_hint: when stressed, she becomes compulsively busy, unable to sit still or accept help; she deflects vulnerability with humor or work; she assumes people will leave if she stops being useful
